title: Professional Email Term Renewals of Active Subscriptions
content:
**Scope.** A term renewal is the renewal of an active Professional Email subscription that falls due on its term end date, billed on or before its due date or, as a late renewal, after it while the subscription status is still active; this rule prices only a term renewal, and every other renewal or instalment remains under the renewal standard.

**Rule.** A term renewal may be charged only while the subscription status is active, and once it is paid the renewed seats become the seat count, the scheduled seat count is reset to 0 and the new term runs from the previous term end date for 1 calendar month on the monthly plan or 12 calendar months on the annual prepaid and annual-billed-monthly plans; on the annual-billed-monthly plan the term renewal is the first monthly instalment of the new term. A late renewal is not collected until the charges of the current term carry at least the seats it renews.

Restated: while the charges of the current term carry fewer seats than a late renewal renews, that late renewal stays uncollected.

**What the customer sees.** A renewal line in the email billing history, charged to the default card on file, whose period starts on the previous term end date; the new term on the subscription is opened by that paid renewal line.

## Tool: `pay_late_mail_renewal_a889cd52`

**Capability.** Collects, on the customer's default card on file, the renewal of an active email subscription that falls due on its term end date, whether it is billed on or before that due date or, overdue, after it went unpaid. One call books one renewal billing line that bills every renewed seat and starts the new term: it runs from the previous term end date for 1 calendar month on the monthly plan or 12 calendar months on the annual prepaid and annual-billed-monthly plans, falling back to the month's last day where that day does not exist, the line being the new term's first monthly instalment on the annual-billed-monthly plan. The licensed seat count becomes the renewed seat count given, the product becomes the renewal product given, and the scheduled seat count and product are cleared.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `email_plan_id` | reference number of the email subscription whose renewal is being collected, as returned by the email subscription lookup for this customer | identifier |
| `renewal_amount` | the renewal amount being collected, in US dollars | positive number with 2 decimal places; more decimals are rounded half up to the cent before booking |
| `renewed_seats` | the number of licensed seats the subscription carries for the new term, every one of them billed on the line | integer of at least 1 |
| `renewal_product` | the product the subscription carries for the new term | one of the official product names: Harborline Mail Starter, Harborline Mail Plus, Harborline Mail Pro, Microsoft 365 Business Basic, Microsoft 365 Business Standard, Microsoft 365 Business Premium |

**Return.** On success: "Paid renewal of subscription <email_plan_id>: line <email_charge_id> order <order_ref> for <amount> USD (<seats> seats) charged to card; new term <term_start> to <term_end>." The order reference is HL- followed by 8 digits; dates are YYYY-MM-DD. A reply starting with "Error:" means nothing was booked: an unknown subscription, a non-positive amount, fewer than 1 seat or an unknown product name.

## Points of judgement

- A suspended subscription has no term renewal; a term renewal is charged only while the status is active.
- A term renewal billed on or before the term end date is not a late renewal.
